children: Asbury Automotive Group appointed Wendy Reynolds-Dobbs as Senior Vice President & Chief Human Resources Officer, effective September 14, 2026.
Wendy Reynolds-Dobbs promoted to SVP & Chief Human Resources Officer, effective Sept. 14, 2026.
Reynolds-Dobbs has served as interim CHRO and VP, Talent Development & Chief Culture Officer since joining in May 2022.
Outgoing SVP & CHRO Jed Milstein will provide consulting services through end of 2026 to ensure transition.
Company says appointment aims to strengthen culture, talent development and guest experience across the organization.
